nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the empty dining room on Friday night: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is the grandmother's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain, jewelry and clothes. Image 3 is her son's character sheet: use it only for his face, skin tone, haircut, beard and clothes. Image 4 is the granddaughter's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, braids, earrings and clothes. Image 5 is the son's wife's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone and hair. Image 6 shows the boy's clothes: use it only for his sleeves. Image 7 is the real product photo of the wooden utensils. Wide shot. The photo shows Friday night in the dining room with no balloons, moving boxes stacked in the hallway seen through the archway; the same family in the same seats as at the birthday; the grandmother at the head of the table setting down the potato salad bowl, a wooden serving spoon in her other hand; at the edge of the frame only the boy's small hands and blue hoodie sleeves rest on the table. The grandmother: a 71-year-old Black American woman with medium-deep brown skin and warm undertones, a round face, short tapered silver-white coily hair, gold-framed reading glasses hanging on a chain at her chest, small gold earrings and a small gold cross. She wears a burgundy sweater, small gold earrings and the same floral cotton apron. Her son: a 46-year-old Black American man with deep brown skin, a low taper fade with a little grey at the temples, a neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a tense jaw and a gold wedding band. He wears a plaid button-down shirt. The granddaughter: a 19-year-old Black American woman with medium brown skin, long knotless braids gathered in a low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings and a bright, expressive face. She wears a green knit sweater. The son's wife: a 44-year-old Black American woman with light-medium brown skin and natural hair in a neat high bun. She wears a soft knit sweater. The son's youngest child, a 10-year-old Black American boy with medium-deep brown skin: only his small hands and forearms appear, at the edge of the table; his face stays out of the frame. His sleeves belong to a plain blue hoodie. The bowl is a large glass bowl of homemade potato salad (potatoes, chopped egg, celery, relish, a light dusting of paprika on top). ACAWOOD SET: solid deep-brown acacia wood utensils with visible natural grain, each carved from a single piece, matte oiled finish (not glossy, not varnished), a small hanging hole near the end of each handle. Exactly seven utensils in the full set: a ladle, a wok spatula, a slotted spoon, a turner, a serving spoon, a mixing spoon and a small spoon. The utensils keep the exact shape of the real product photo. Lighting match: the wooden utensils are lit by exactly the same light as the rest of the scene: the same direction, color temperature, softness and exposure, with soft highlights on the side facing the main light and matching shade on the far side, a soft contact shadow where they touch the counter, towel or a hand. The same grain, softness and color grade as the rest of the photo, the same perspective, and a realistic size (the ladle about 33 cm long). Use Image 7 only for the shapes, number, grain and color of the wood; ignore its lighting, background and shadows. It must look photographed together in one shot, never pasted in or cut out. Food with the wooden utensils: fresh, bright and appetizing, neatly served; the bowl, plates, pot, counter and table are clean and tidy. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: warm evening light from a small chandelier, soft shadows, warm family-film color. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: the grandmother is the same woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain and gold jewelry; her son is the same man as in his character sheet, with the same skin tone, haircut and beard; the granddaughter is the same young woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone and braids; the son's wife is the same woman as in her character sheet. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.
